Justify: this longer paragraph demonstrates automatic line wrapping and justified spacing. Resize the text box to compare how words fill each wrapped line. Each paragraph keeps its own alignment while the final line follows the paragraph's normal ending behavior.

text-indent: 0 — the first line starts at the normal paragraph edge. Wrapped lines use the same edge.
text-indent: 64px — the first line begins 64 text units inward. This paragraph is long enough to wrap in a narrow text box, making it easy to compare the indented first line with the remaining lines.
text-indent: 10% — the first line indent scales with the paragraph layout width. Resize the text box to see the indent change while the following lines retain their normal starting edge.
text-indent: -3em — a negative value moves the first line outward. Allow space around the text box to see the hanging first line.
Zero margins: margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0.
Pixel margins: margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px.
Font-relative margins: margin-top: 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em. Block margins use the component font size (32), not the outer font tag.
Percentage margins: margin-top: 1%; margin-bottom: 1%. Percentages use the container height.
Margin collapse, paragraph A: bottom margin = 16px.
Margin collapse, paragraph B: top margin = 32px. The shared margin is 32px; component paragraph spacing is added separately.
